title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.

Without mode conditioning, replay content contaminates external-task selection.

title: dACC conflict saturation: the dACC-analog (SD-032b) prediction-error / conflict signal caps and habituates under repeated identical outcomes; it does not grow unboundedly as conflict persists. Without saturation, a stuck governance loop can generate unbounded pe signal that never triggers a mode change, which is the control-theory signature of persistent rumination.
subject: dacc.conflict_saturation

title: MECH-271 routing is state-gated. In waking, the anchor channel dominates the hippocampal fan-out: replay preferentially reaches consolidation and viability-map consumers to support decision-making. In sleep, the probe channel dominates: replay preferentially seeds Bayesian schema restructuring -- testing which action-outcome attributions held up across episodes, creating new buckets for non-fitting experiences, revising causal graphs. The informational needs of sleep (schema revision) and waking (decision support) are distinct, and the routing bias reflects that.
subject: hippocampus.state_gated_routing

title: The self-model has a waking half and a sleep half. The waking half is SD-003 (single-episode counterfactual self-attribution via E2). The sleep half is full-Bayesian aggregation of single-episode SD-003 outputs across many episodes, routed by the anchored channel to E1 and SD-033a, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases. Without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model.
subject: self_model.sleep_dependent_aggregation

title: PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.
subject: pag.gabaergic_freeze_gate

title: V_s residual schema-staleness accumulator: a region-indexed scalar that integrates broadcast invalidation events (MECH-287) with attribution_weight credit assignment over the active anchor set, leaks slowly, and is read by both online anchor-reset (MECH-269 hysteresis check, waking) and sleep-consolidation priority (MECH-285, offline). Distinct from generic prediction error (which operates on latent values and updates online via gradient): MECH-284 is region-indexed, accumulates across events, and exposes a dual read-out (online + offline). Refined 2026-04-22 from sleep-only formulation to dual-readout formulation after V3-EXQ-475 demonstrated that an agent trapped in a stale anchor needs an online consumer of the staleness signal -- MECH-285 sleep-only readout cannot rescue the agent during waking. Saturated map produces over-attention to schema revision (anxiety-analog); absent map produces schema rigidity (V3-EXQ-475 phenotype: 5-6 PAG releases per seed but never integrate to anchor invalidation -> 1000/1000 freeze-active steps).
subject: hippocampal.v_s_residual_schema_staleness_accumulator

title: Dual-component online invalidation trigger: an UPSTREAM anchor-side comparator (CA1/CA3 mismatch flowing through subicular routing per Vinogradova 2001 + O'Mara 2009) coupled to a DOWNSTREAM broadcast event (LC phasic burst per Aston-Jones-Cohen 2005, with parallel signals from generalised dopaminergic prediction error per Schultz 1997 and lateral habenula negative-RPE per Matsumoto-Hikosaka 2007), wired together by the HC-VTA loop (Lisman & Grace 2005). The two components are coupled stages of one trigger event, not alternatives. Distinct from MECH-284 the accumulator: MECH-287 is the discrete trigger event (anchor-side mismatch + broadcast release) that drives accumulation. Triggered by latent-stream prediction failure (norm(z_pred(t-1) - z_obs(t)) > theta_trigger) OR strongly negative value-PE (value_PE(t) < -theta_value) OR exogenous surprise. Carries no schema-region credit on its own; downstream MECH-284 attributes the broadcast event to the active anchor set. Failure modes dissociate from MECH-284: trigger-loss produces single-event blindness (no anchor ever feels invalidated, but staleness map remains queryable); accumulator-loss produces V3-EXQ-475's phenotype directly (releases happen but never integrate). Failure modes also dissociate from MECH-285 sleep priority: trigger-loss prevents staleness from accruing, while sleep-priority loss prevents accrued staleness from being repaired. Within MECH-287 itself, anchor-side comparator failure dissociates from broadcast failure: comparator-loss = no upstream signal to broadcast (silent trigger, biologically a CA1/CA3 lesion); broadcast-loss = comparator fires but no global gain modulation downstream (silent invalidation, biologically an LC lesion).
subject: regulators.broadcast_invalidation_trigger

title: Event-segment detection: a substrate-side two-level hierarchical detector that emits monotonic outer.inner segment IDs on detected event boundaries, feeding region-keyed substrates (anchor sets per MECH-269, V_s readouts per Phase 1, staleness accumulators per MECH-284) and the MECH-287 broadcast trigger at the schema/event-segment scale per Eichenbaum 2017 / Sols-DuBrow-Davachi 2017 / Baldassano 2017. Default substrate: PE-threshold detector on the fast scale (z_world+z_self) and BOCPD-Gaussian latent change-point on the slow scale (z_goal); MECH-287 broadcast fires downstream of MECH-288 boundaries (Clewett 2025) rather than via an independent comparator. The segment_id field is the region key consumed by the V_s invalidation runtime cluster; without it, MECH-269 anchor sets and per-region V_s aggregation have no substrate-native source for the region partition.
subject: hippocampal.event_segmenter

title: Relief-completion event reuses goal-achievement / reward-circuit completion machinery. When a comparator on a suffering-stream derivative crosses a downward threshold (sustained suffering-reduction below baseline), the resulting event fires the same downstream tag-and-release pipeline as goal-achievement: MECH-057a (commitment-release / beta-gate-drop), MECH-091 (salient-event phase-reset), and MECH-094 (categorical hypothesis-tag write gate). The polarity of the reinforcement is set at the input -- what counts as the completion is the suffering-derivative crossing, not a reward-onset event -- but the consolidation pipeline is shared. 'Things that just reduced suffering' are tagged in the same approach-attractor structure as 'things liked'.
subject: relief.completion_event_reuses_goal_achievement_pipeline

title: Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).
subject: safety_prediction.contextual_passive_substrate

title: Cue-specific conditioned safety prediction: a discrete predictive structure encodes 'this stimulus actively predicts that suffering will be omitted', updated by explicit MECH-302 relief-completion events as its teaching signal. Encoding substrate is cortico-striatal (dorsal striatum + dlPFC). Expression/output pathway is IL-to-CeA. This is the conditioned-inhibition mechanism: when a specific cue co-occurs with relief, a separate learned prediction forms that can gate avoidance commitment release when the cue is later present. Sister claim to MECH-303 (contextual passive safety representation).
subject: safety_prediction.cue_specific_conditioned_inhibition_substrate

title: z_goal seeding under SD-012 requires sustained drive at contact, not instantaneous homeostatic drive alone: when the agent is well-fed, drive_level collapses at consumption and anti-correlates with benefit_exposure, so effective_benefit cannot cross the seeding threshold unless drive is floored or slow-traced.
subject: goal_seeding.sustained_drive_trace

title: novelty_bonus_striatal_analog. A reward bonus that tracks recency-of-encounter; new or rarely-encountered states/actions receive a positive bonus independent of reward prediction error. Biological substrate: ventral striatum response to stimulus novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus.
subject: policy.curiosity.novelty_bonus_striatal_analog

title: simulation_mode_rule_write_gating_categorical_replay_tag (SWR_machinery_substrate_REE_novel_function). The substrate-level instantiation of MECH-094's hypothesis-tag write gate at the rule-arbitration layer: a categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation-mode tag that suppresses arbitration-weight updates during ghost / replay / DMN passes, allowing rule-arbitration to be exercised without overwriting the active rule weights from non-realized data. Substrate-availability premise is well-anchored: SWR machinery (Joo & Frank 2018 review) + reverse-replay discriminable signature (Foster & Wilson 2006). The specific REE function (categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation tag suppressing arbitration-weight updates) is plausible biologically but unverified at cellular / synaptic level.
subject: policy.arbitration.simulation_mode_write_gating_substrate_ree_novel_function

title: e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).
subject: ethics_engine_3.scoring_trajectory_class_diversity_preservation

title: Cross-model super-additivity: integrating predictive models over a shared latent yields capability gains that EXCEED the sum of the isolated models, because shared features let each model's prediction-error corrections propagate to the others. Integrated (E1 world-model + E2 affordance-model [+ object spine]) beats a param/compute-matched bag of isolated modules -- the 'cross-pollination turbo-charges development' claim, made falsifiable.
subject: integration.cross_model_super_additivity

title: Conflict-graded near-tie lever sufficiency: a hyperdirect-STN-like conflict-graded shortlist / commit-temperature lever (k = f(top-F gap); T = f(top-F gap)) is SUFFICIENT to lift committed-action-class entropy strict-above both collapsed-proposer and gap-blind controls -- gap-CONCENTRATED (the lift correlates with per-tick top-F gap) -- WITHOUT reducing F's E3 variance share. I.e. F can keep monopolising selection variance and conversion is still recovered by widening/hotting only at near-ties.
subject: selection.conflict_graded_near_tie_sufficiency

title: Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.
subject: selection.go_nogo_eligibility_constitution
